facts.rationale: The shared exit routine identifies both records, and the merger body exposes conditional writes to both arguments.
facts.value: Forwards the departing GameModeState to gmVsMelee_ExitSuddenDeath, which passes gmVsMelee_VsExitInfo.match_end and the separate exit payload's match_end to gm_80166CCC. That routine selectively merges outcome and standings information rather than replacing the complete record; its guarded processing can also modify the Sudden Death input standings.

facts.value: Handles Lightning Melee's Sudden Death exit by delegating the selective integration of tiebreaker outcome and standings into the shared ordinary Versus match-end record used by subsequent Results entry.

facts.rationale: Separates branch-free wrapper behavior from guarded cross-file processing.
facts.value: Runs on exit from Lightning state 3, GS_SUDDEN_DEATH. The wrapper unconditionally delegates and chooses no next state itself. Downstream merging conditionally propagates OUTCOME_NO_CONTEST or OUTCOME_RETRY and updates player/team standings under winner-count and participation guards; it is not an unconditional replacement of all match-end state.

evidence.why: Shared persistent record and speed-hook registrations.

facts.rationale: Corrects ambiguous ordering and preserves the distinction between persistent configuration and the constructed battle payload.
facts.value: Selection and gameplay wrappers share gmMainLib_804D3EE0->modes.vs_lightning. Ordinary gameplay setup first updates that persistent configuration through gm_80167BC8. Both ordinary and Sudden Death builders copy persistent rules into the scene's StartMeleeData, invoke fn_801BA7AC to overwrite destination rules.game_speed with 1.25F, and then copy player records. Both Lightning wrappers supply NULL per-player callbacks. Sudden Death additionally consumes the prior ordinary match-end record.
